0.

FOREWORD

0.1 This Indian Standard was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution on 30 November 1984, after the draft finalized by the Pgricultural Tractors and Power Tillers Sectional Committee had been approved by the Agricultural and Food Products Division Council. 0.2 Wet land cultivation, popularly known as puddling is an important tillage operation in the cultivation of transplanted paddy. The agricultural tractors are increasingly being used for Lj'et Iancl cultivation. The success of mechanized paddy cultivation with the agricultural tractors depend upon how efficiently it can be operated in wet paddy fields. 11 need was, therefore, felt to formulate an lndian Standard on this subject for the guidance of the manufacturers and users. 0.3 In the formulation derived from the Central 13udni. of this Indian Standard, Farm Machinery Training assistance has been and Testing Institute,
